status: Qualified connected structural cave volumes, native editor presentation and standalone underground sculpt persistence on bounded reference recipes

delivery.geometry: Connected negative volumes in native VPP terrain, with curved variable-section passages, irregular enlarged junction spaces, branches and developing loops/lower levels. Native terrain meshes their floors, walls and ceilings.
delivery.editor: Existing eye/indicator/one knob/reseed/native expansion; dimmed globe and all actual generated cave surfaces together; no automatic camera change, selection mode or new UI container.

delivery.minimum: Every enabled knob position requests at least one complete eligible cave; only the eye requests zero. Impossible prerequisites/fit explicitly refuse.
delivery.compatibility: Intentional correction of unreleased cave morphology under existing recipe schema/fields; authored advanced values and saved asset bytes preserved. New defaults match the revised middle profile.
